scope: standalone reconstruction device and engine regressions

findings.reproduction: A grounded kind:crate body on a requiredPlayers:1 lift incorrectly satisfied its player quorum.
findings.resolution: Lift occupancy accepts kind:player or legacy untyped player bodies; a crate cannot satisfy the quorum.
findings.test: crate is physical obstruction but cannot count as lift rider

findings.reproduction: A bridge signal could activate while a falling body intersected its rectangle.
findings.resolution: Bridge activation waits until intersecting bodies clear the solid volume.
findings.test: bridge creation waits until falling body clears its volume

findings.reproduction: Gate closure checked bodies but ignored overlapping solid devices such as lifts.
findings.resolution: Gate closure and bridge activation include other currently solid devices in the overlap check.
findings.test: closing gate and appearing bridge wait for solid lift to clear

findings.reproduction: Transient exit overlap combined with solid players made larger groups unable to share the narrow door.
findings.resolution: With the shared key, entering players retain exit admission and leave the active collision and occupancy simulation. Clear requires every player admitted.
findings.test: 2, 4 and 8 players enter a narrow exit sequentially and stay entered

findings.observedImplementation: Walking into the initial gap without jumping causes a fall failure.
findings.sourceLimit: The observed original video does not show a fall into this gap. The developer talk about safe failure examples does not prove this particular gap is safe.
findings.resolution: Keep unresolved; compare original failure behavior before changing the stage.

limits: 1-1 two-player route completed with simulated input frames; not a claim of human fun evaluation.
Coordinates, speeds, collision tolerances and 3-8 player adaptations are not measured original-game constants.
No complete 4-8 player route run has been verified.
